image_note: After ID validation, the buscheck image writes and immediately reads Scratch16 with each byte 00..FF; page 0 reports verified count (256 means all passed) and the first mismatch expected/actual bytes (zero initially). It then runs the original 55/AA tests, IF08 check, FC61 reset with 1 ms fixed wait and FC41 readback, and the four long-window termination phases. Page 2 is the post-settle Debug15 mask and page 3 is the RxCmd mask plus capture-time global RxCmd/RxData totals. Phase RxCmd histories include intermediate configuration/detach and have no timestamps. A zero phase mask means no event, not SE0. Register responses and turnaround cycles are excluded. Global counters may increase after DONE; phase histories freeze. No USB device protocol runs; the final state is detached. This validates digital register transport, not analog signal quality or device enumeration.
note: CSV time labels are retained as exported; they do not establish USB bit timing. CSV contains no GAO ID; select the image layout matching the capture record. Each complete 0,1,2,3 cycle contains eight samples per page and is coherent because the observer commits its 128-bit mailbox only before page 0. There is no snapshot sequence or freshness flag: a capture need not contain a newly acknowledged snapshot, and repeated page cycles may show the same previous snapshot. Before any 60 MHz acknowledgement, payload pages are zero. The clock count is a separate 10 ms measurement; zero persists after a full stopped-clock window. This is not a complete ULPI or USB protocol trace.
